issues.title: Side-block lumbar pillows cover the new draped belts; y_47301 / y_47303 have no pillows on those seats
issues.evidence: q17 teal px 134 vs y_47303 3785, and the r41 -> r42 q17 diff is only 0.73 % (bands y 300-450 at 0.6-2.4 %). In the q17 zoom (z17.png vs z17p.png) every near seat has a navy pillow standing on the rear half of the pan, and only 2-4 cm of each strap shows past it. In y_47303 and in the left 3-seat block of y_47301 the pans are bare and the straps and buckles lie in full view. Only y_47300 (the centre block) shows pillows.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: build the pillow only for the 4-seat centre block (D-G), in step with the belt staging split (side blocks draped, centre tucked). Drop it on A-C and H-K, or move it upright against the seat back so its foot clears the pan by at least 8 cm. Check: q17 teal px >= 1500, q16 teal px >= 2000, and the q15 pillow E box and light px unchanged.

issues.title: Belt webbing too dark and over-saturated vs the grey-blue webbing in the photos
issues.evidence: Visible strap px in q17 r42: #1f508f, #22538f and #21538f (n 274 / 101 / 200; L about 70, B/R 4.6, G/R 2.6). y_47303 webbing px (L > 80): mean #4c73ae, L110, B/R 2.29, G/R 1.51. In y_47301 they are #557bb6, L119. The studio renders the strap as cyan #4ea4d7 (G/R 2.1). The w42 change #25466a -> #2d5c90 raised B/R from 2.83 to 3.2, moving away from the photo.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js SEATMAT.yBelt '#2d5c90' -> '#4a6aa0' (B/R 2.17, G/R 1.43), with roughness about 0.6 so it doesn't glint. Check: the q17 strap px mean is L 95-120 with B/R 2.0-2.6 and G/R 1.35-1.7, and the s42 e7 strap no longer reads cyan (G/R <= 1.7).

issues.title: Draped belt is rigid, kinked flat boxes that all converge on a mid-pan latch
issues.evidence: s42 e7 / e11: the navy strap is 3-4 straight segments with visible steps at the joins. It floats as flat slabs, its thickness edges are visible, and it doesn't follow the pan's crown. Every side seat uses the same symmetric V. In y_47303 the near seat's latch lies near the aisle armrest, with the teal strap running fore-aft and the navy strap lapping over the pan front edge. In the second row the tongue hangs at the armrest.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js belt loop: build the straps as one swept ribbon whose path samples the pan surface height (loftAt) every 3-4 cm, sitting 2 mm proud. Vary the layout per seat: on every second side seat, move the latch 10-12 cm toward the aisle armrest and drape the navy end 3-4 cm over the front edge. Check: no step > 2 px in the s42 e7 strap edges, and the q17 near-seat strap reaches the pan front (y >= 450 at x 520-560).
